messages:
ana (Sales): Heads-up: ScaleBank wants BYOK with HSM-backed keys for the POC. They asked for rotation every 24h, proof keys never leave HSM, and audit stream to their SIEM. Can we support that without a Private deployment?
ravi (Solutions Eng): Quick note: Hosted tier uses Redwood-managed keys so BYOK with customer HSM isn't possible there. Two practical paths: 1) Dedicated pool with customer KMS (CloudHSM-backed CMK) integration; 2) Private (VPC/on-prem) if they need physical custody. For a short POC Dedicated is usually fastest.
nana (Sales): Typo — ana.
lena (Security): For the questionnaire: we should be explicit that we do not accept exported HSM private keys. Cloud providers' HSMs (AWS CloudHSM, Azure HSM) keep key material non-exportable. We can integrate via KMS APIs and rely on provider attestation (FIPS, etc.).
nana (Sales): Thanks. Can we give them a short POC checklist and an example rotation cron snippet they can show their SecOps?
ravi (Solutions Eng): POC checklist (short): 1) Customer creates CMK in their KMS with HSM-backed protection. 2) Grant Redwood service principal Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/DescribeKey. 3) Provision a small Dedicated pool scoped for the POC. 4) Run encrypt/decrypt test, exercise rotation, and verify CloudTrail logs forwarded to customer SIEM. 5) Measure latency during rotation window.
ravi (Solutions Eng): Example rotation scheduling note for AWS KMS: set CloudWatch Events to invoke a rotation Lambda or use KMS automatic rotation for symmetric CMKs (note: KMS automatic rotation is yearly by default; for 24h you'll need a custom scheduler that triggers GenerateDataKey/Rotate operations).
lena (Security): Add: rotation frequency of 24h is achievable but increases key-ops and may impact cold-start latency. Recommend testing impact on tokenization/warm caches. Also require the customer to accept the SOW clause that they retain key control and Redwood does not escrow key material.
sam (Finance): Pricing: short Dedicated POC rates apply (prorated node hours) + one-time integration fee for KMS onboarding. I'll estimate once we know pool size; for initial ballpark flag it as "Dedicated POC + KMS setup" charge.
nana (Sales): Nice. Could you draft the exact wording for the security questionnaire answers? I want concise bullets.
lena (Security): Draft bullets you can paste: - HSM support: Supported via customer-managed KMS with HSM-backed CMKs (AWS CloudHSM, Azure HSM). - BYOK: Supported on Dedicated and Private; not supported on Hosted. - Rotation: Custom rotation policies supported; 24h possible with custom scheduling but may affect latency. - Audit logs: KMS provider logs (CloudTrail/Monitor) plus Redwood request traces can be correlated; we can assist forwarding. - Key export/escrow: Customer key material is non-exportable; Redwood does not escrow private key material. - Attestation: We can provide HSM vendor attestation docs and describe integration steps.
ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a small example snippet to show how to grant permissions and a minimal CloudWatch event to run rotation.
deploy-bot: Deployment job redwood-dedicated/poc-scale started by ravi at 1765437200.
nana (Sales): Great. I'll send this to ScaleBank and ask for their KMS account IDs, desired rotation window, and whether they require on-prem HSM. Keep this thread for follow-ups.
